All four scenarios moved DOWN: P-02 7942->7912 (-30), P-03 14002->13939 (-63), P-04 7335->7307 (-28), P-05 2408->2396 (-12). Measured against a CONTROL: develop's tip (80890ea2), the branch's base, reproduced the outgoing baseline exactly on the CI runner (7942/14002/7335/2408), and the local capture of this change reproduced the CI capture of it exactly, so the deltas are this change's own.
